fields.reason: The paper explicitly reports an experiment comparing a retrieval-augmented model (R) against a parametric-only model (B) on the LawFactQA benchmark.

selector.exact: We include the parametric-only model, which relies on its parametric knowledge alone and never sees an external source; we denote it by B. We include the retrieval-augmented model, which retrieves passages from the reference collection and conditions its answer on them; we denote it by R.
